monster_goblin2.title: the
monster_goblin2.name: two-eyed goblin
monster_goblin2.information: This goblin is a bit tougher than the last one. He will maybe not be that that easy to kill. He also has a butter knife and leather armor!
death_messages: He cuts your head off. You will may ask how he does that with a butter knife? Well, it takes lots of time and is a lot of Pain, but this doesn't matter to you. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} grit{atk.s} {atk.poss_adjective} teeth and tighten{atk.s} {atk.poss_adjective} grip around the butter knife.
text.on_hit: {atk.name} grab{atk.s} {def.owns} arm and saws at it with {atk.poss_adjective} butter knife!
text.on_kill: {atk.name} grab{atk.s} {def.owns} arm and saws at it with {atk.poss_adjective} butter knife! Finally, the arm comes off and {def.name} dies of {def.blood} loss!
text.on_dodge: The butter on {atk.owns} knife causes the attack to slip away.
text.on_armor_save: Since {def.name} is not made of butter, the butter knife doesn't do any damage.

monster_snake1.title: the
monster_snake1.name: poisonous snake
monster_snake1.information: This is an poisonous snake. I think that's nuff said.
death_messages: It tries to strangle you, and you try to bite it. It is poisonous, so you die. You are dead.

text.wind_up: {atk.name} coil{atk.s} up, ready to fling {atk.reflexive} out and bite.
text.on_hit: {atk.name} bite{atk.s} {def.name} in the thigh! Luckily for {def.object}, {atk.name} {atk.are} poisonous, not venomous!
text.on_kill: {atk.name} bite{atk.s} {def.name} in the neck, and severe{atk.s} {def.poss_adjective} jugular!

monster_paperman!.name: paper-man!
monster_paperman!.information: This is a superhero, completely out of paper. Their arms are really sharp, so watch out you dont get hit! What can I say except fire?
death_messages: They cut you several times, till you die of wound infection. You are dead.
Paper cuts are nasty, and hurt like hell. The pain kills you. You are dead.

monster_fat_lady.title: the
monster_fat_lady.name: really fat old lady
monster_fat_lady.information: Now this is probably the owner of the really fat cat. I think they are fitting very well. So same as the cat. Her name is Agnes, btw.
death_messages: She sits down on you, and you get squished. Yeah, she is REALLY fat. You are dead.

text.on_hit: {atk.name} batter{atk.s} {def.name} over the head with {atk.poss_adjective} ton-heavy handbag!

monster_child_soldier.title: the
monster_child_soldier.name: Child Soldier
monster_child_soldier.information: Well, it is a Child. With an AK-47. Its heavy-armored with kevlar, but has a terrible precision. That should be easy, right?
death_messages: It finally manages to shot you in the head. You are dead.

text.on_kill: {atk.owns} hastily-shot bullet hits {def.name}, and hits a vital organ!

text.on_hit: {atk.name} take{atk.s} time to land a well-placed shot on {def.name}!
text.on_kill: {atk.name} take{atk.s} time to land a well-placed shot on {def.name}, destroying a vital organ!
